narrative: A loose leaf, not the tables and not the red bundle. The bundle sits apart, knotted. The tables are shut. One candle. The leaf is blank. No face. Four words, then a smear where a fifth was rubbed. The bundle has not been touched. No face. The four words remain. The rubbed place is pale. He has not written a drink. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the page on a loose leaf and did not open the fair copy.
